spans.s:
मोटक mn. (-कः-कं) A pill.
 n. (-कं) Two broken blades of kuśa grass.

मोटकी f. (-की) One of the Rāginīs or female personification of the
musical modes.

मोटन m. (-नः) Air, wind.
 n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, pressing.
 E. मुट् to rub, &c. aff. ल्युट् ।
. A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.

मोट्टायित n. (-तं) One of the ten Bhāvas, or properties of women, the
silent expression of returned affection.
